findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed mouse droppings on the floor of the dry storage area, as well as on top of unused dish racks that are stored inside of the dish room. The facility has active pest control, however, frequent cleaning should occur to eliminate harboring conditions. The floor in the dry storage area contained spilled foods, which are environments that keep insects and pests around to feed. Additionally, a dead insect was observed underneath the triple sink inside of the dish room.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Despite the kitchen being in full operation, there wasn't a sanitizer solution present. A sanitizer solution was created and tested at 200ppm (quat) to correct the violation. Ensure that there is always a sanitizer solution present if food handling, preparing, or serving is occurring.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: There was a significant amount of ice buildup on the shelves, floor, and food items inside of the walk in freezer. PIC mentioned that the facility has noticed the increase of ice buildup due to the humidity outdoors. The gasket of the freezer door is broken, as well as other parts of the door are broken, not allowing it to close properly. Ensure that the door and the gasket is replaced to prevent the accumulation of ice buildup.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed a dented can of v8 juice to be stored on a shelf in the walk in cooler. The dent was observed on the bottom seam of the can. The can was pulled from the shelf by the PIC and discarded to correct the violation. Ensure that food packages are in good condition and never dented on the seams, as this can expose food to possible contaminants.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: There were at least three containers of strawberries that contained mold on the food surfaces. Shown to PIC and the containers were discarded to correct the violation. Ensure that food items are presented safely and never containing mold.
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed at least three dead insects on the floors of the dish room and the dry storage area. PIC mentioned that the facility has Presto X as their treatment provider. Presto X services the facility once a month. Discussed with PIC the need of routinely cleaning and preventing harboring conditions for insects. Ensure that the facility is cleaned at a frequency to prevent the presence of unwanted insects.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: There was a leak observed at the faucet of the triple sink (in dish room). PIC mentioned that the maintenance team was made aware of the leak prior to the inspection. Ensure that the faucet is repaired and is in leak free condition.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Overall, the facility could use a bit of a deep cleaning. A build up of food debris, grease splatter, and other accumulation were observed on the sides and behind pieces of equipment, countertops of prep area, floors of the main cook-line, and on shelves that store clean utensils/pans. The PIC was informed and educated on routinely cleaning to prevent debris accumulation. When there is down time and time permits, pull pieces of equipment from wall to thoroughly clean and create a frequent cleaning schedule to clean areas that are hard to reach.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is a gap between the dish table and the wall (behind the dish sprayer). Discussed with PIC that the space is in need of caulking. Ensure that the area is re-caulked to prevent the accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.comment: The ice shoot of the ice machine that’s stored in the serving area was observed to have soiled surfaces. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent soil accumulation and contamination.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility could not locate any test strips for the sanitizer that’s being used (quat). The facility plans to get test strips ordered soon. Ensure that test strips are available to accurately measure sanitizer concentrations.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.116 Warewashing Equipment, Determining Chemical Sanitizer Concentration. Concentration of the SANITIZING solution shall be accurately determined by using a test kit or other device.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility could not locate a temperature measuring device for the dish machine. PIC mentioned that the device was loaned to a different facility. Ensure that a temperature measuring device is available to accurately measure the sanitizing temperature of the dish machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.13(B) Temperature Measuring Devices, Manual and Mechanical Warewashing. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The top inside surface of the microwave (near the toaster oven) was observed to be soiled with dried food debris. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that nonfood-contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent accumulation.

- Also, the side of the oven next to the deep freezer is heavily soiled with grease buildup. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that nonfood-contact surfaces are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed several gallons of milk to exceed the manufacturer’s use-by-date in the standing cooler. The fat free milks were dated 7/19/2024 and 7/26/2024 and the 2% milk was dated 7/30/2024. Discussed with PIC and milks were pulled from the cooler and discarded. Ensure that milks never exceed the manufacturer’s use-by-date and are discarded if not used within 7 days of opening. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
PIC stated that the heat puck for the dish machine is lacking batteries. Inspector provided thermometer strips to record the machine’s sanitizing temperature. Ensure that a heat puck, thermometer strip, or any other testing device is available to properly test the sanitizing temperature of the dish machine. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the top inside surface of the microwave to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC. Ensure inside surfaces of the microwave are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent soil buildup. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed at least two employees turning off faucet handles without a barrier after the hand washing process. Discussed with PIC to educate employees on proper hand washing techniques. Ensure that employees are using barriers to turn off faucet handles after washing hands in order to prevent recontaminating freshly washed hands.  

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
Observed a dented can on the rack in the walk in cooler. Discussed with PIC and can was pulled to be discarded/credited. Ensure that cans are in good condition in order to protect food from contamination. 

3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.comment:

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 

Multiple dented cans are observed in the facility. The items were moved for credit/discard by the PIC to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Two sets of tongs are observed with stickers partially dissolved off of the food contact ends. The PIC is instructed to ensure that the stickers are removed as this can become and pathogen reservoir. The stickers were removed to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Equipment such as water and ice dispensing nozzles shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

Ice machine dispensing shoot was observed with buildup from drink splash on the lower surface. PIC was advised on cleaning. Ensure the surfaces of ice machine dispensing nozzle are cleaned and sanitized daily/as needed.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Food debris is observed still on the meat at slicer in the kitchen. PIC indicated that it was likely most recently used yesterday. Ensure thorough cleaning of the food contact surfaces after use and prior to storage. The equipment was disassembled for cleaning to correct.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15 Outer openings of a food establishment shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

Outer door to kitchen by manager’s office was observed in disrepair. The bottom left corner of the door was damaged, and light was visible at both bottom corners of the back door. Gap at bottom right corner was large enough for a writing utensil to fit through. Provide repairs to seal the gaps at the bottom corners of the outer door.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned. 

Bottom inside ice scoop holder had buildup of general debris. Holder and ice scoop were cleaned and sanitized during the inspection. Ensure scoop and holder are cleaned and sanitized daily/as needed to eliminate buildup.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned. 

Multiple pairing knives are observed in an eighth pan that is also holding writing pens. Pens are not considered a cleanable/ sanitized surface and should be stored separately from food contact surfaces. The knives were moved to dish for cleaning. Ensure that these items are stored separately moving foreword.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. 

Clean pan lids are observe in soiled containers in the dry storage room. The situation was discussed with the PIC. They are aware that the food contact items should be stored in clean containers to maintain the items clean prior to use.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Multiple location throughout the facility need repair: 1) the wall above the grill by the hood system needs sealed; 2) the gap around the top of the hand sink needs resealed; 3) The corner of the wall to the right of the dish machine appears to have lost its corner seal. Repair these locations so that they are smooth  and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Employee entered kitchen with their cellphone in hand as they went to the time clock to log in. Employee was then observed going about tasks and getting ready for lunch service without first washing hands. Employee was advised on handwashing between tasks and prior to working with food and clean equipment. Employee washed their hands before continuing to next task. Ensure staff are properly washing hands upon entering the kitchen, after clocking in for work, and after handling personal items such as cell phones. 
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands shall also be washed after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 1. Walls were observed with general buildup and splash in the dish area under the 3 part sink, dish machine and drain boards. 
2. Floor was soiled with buildup and in need of detail cleaning along the walls in dish area.
3. Floor along the wall under counter in back prep area was soiled with food debris. 
Clean the floors and walls in the aforementioned areas. Ensure cleaning of floor drains as needed also.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625  Sec. 3.06 Employee working at time of inspection did not have a copy of certification. Employee has worked at the facility  longer than 30 days and stated they have a food manager certification. Employee needs to provide a copy of manager certification. If manager certification cannot be obtained or is expired, ensure employee completes the food handler certification before the next routine inspection. 
All food handlers, other than someone who has a food manager certification, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
